checks.description: Compiled public types accept the two sizes, two paddings, three layouts and two directions and reject unsupported values.
Omitted variants resolve to small size, default padding and layout, vertical direction, and enabled state.
onPress or presence of selected (including false) enables overlay; absent both remains static; disabled does not remove structure.
Horizontal direction resolves vertical below 480 window layout units, remains horizontal at/above 480 and refreshes on resize; vertical stays vertical.
Overlay comes first when interactive; default renders content, nested content/content02, structured header/content/optional content02/footer; omitted slots do not render.
Compiled public types require root/content and accept the optional View slots.
Supplied View slot props and content are preserved without injecting typography or a content schema.

Small/large radii, thin border, 720 maxWidth, default/none padding, section gaps and nested inset radii match tokens; selection then disabled then pressed/hover determine colors and caller root style is final.
Selected overlay reports selected and resolves selected rest/hover/pressed surface colors; system focus request remains on overlay.

tests.name: Card renders selected colors and hover, press, and focus feedback

checks.description: Windows/macOS overlay requests native ring; Win32 custom ring stays mounted, keyboard/self-focus gated, hidden when disabled and retains surface radius; root never owns focus visual.
Review nested/structured/edge-to-edge layouts, responsive stacking and overlay ring clipping on every renderer.
Explicit accessible static card exposes supplied label with group role.

tests.name: Card exposes static group semantics when explicitly requested

checks.description: Disabled selected overlay is disabled/unfocusable, preserves selected and blocks press without disabling nested Help action.

tests.name: Card CRD-004 CRD-005 disables the overlay without disabling a nested action

checks.description: Default static root is nonfocusable/inaccessible but slot controls remain accessible; interactive structural root is hidden and named overlay carries button/disabled/optional selected with caller state preserved.
Native pointer/touch/Enter/Space activate named overlay once; disabled rejects focus/activation; pending ref requests invalidate on detach/disable and root ref remains structural.
UIA/AX exposes overlay name/button/state or opted-in static group without concealing independently accessible slot controls.
Press forwards once without changing externally supplied selected=false.

tests.name: Card renders selection without changing it on press

checks.description: Nested controls activate independently of overlay for pointer and keyboard; card adds no focus trap, collection navigation, destination or timed animation.

limitations: The responsive threshold is window width, not measured card width; boundary checks must use the contract's window metric.
Structural root hiding must not be interpreted as hiding slot controls; actual UIA/AX traversal needs manual qualification.
Synthetic overlay presses and style assertions do not prove native hit testing, nested focus, ring pixels or selected projection.
